title: Turn one idea into five posts

sources.name: Prompting guidance: give context, constraints and an output format

caption:
5 prompts to turn one idea into a week of content: angles, hooks, an outline, caption options and repurposed versions.
Use them as drafts, add your own experience, and never copy another creator's work.
Save this content set. Comment IDEAS and I will send the prompt list.

slides.headline: Begin with your own idea
body: Use your experience, your examples and your voice.

slides.headline: Find five angles
slides.prompt: Give me five different angles for a post about [idea] for [audience]: a how-to, a mistake, a list, a story and a question.

slides.headline: Write stronger hooks
body: The first line decides if people keep reading.
slides.prompt: Write ten opening lines for a post about [idea]. Keep each under twelve words. No exaggerated claims.

slides.headline: Outline the post
body: One point per slide or paragraph.
slides.prompt: Outline a ten-slide carousel about [idea]. One point per slide, a clear hook on slide one and a call to action on the last.

slides.headline: Try caption options
body: Pick the one that sounds like you.
slides.prompt: Write three caption options for this post: [summary]. Include a keyword phrase, one clear takeaway and a simple call to action.

slides.headline: Repurpose it
body: Turn one post into a few formats.
slides.prompt: Turn this post [text] into a short video script, a three-sentence caption and five quote lines. Keep the meaning the same.

slides.headline: Add what only you know
body: Your examples and results make the post worth saving.

slides.headline: Never copy another creator
body: Learn formats, but write your own words and make your own images.

slides.headline: Save this content set
body: Comment IDEAS and I will send the prompt list.
Share this with a creator who is out of ideas.
